sections.title: Listening Part 1: Campus Student Accommodation Services
sections.titleVi: Phần Nghe Part 1: Đăng ký Ký túc xá & Dịch vụ Sinh viên
sections.instructions: Answer Questions 1-5. Complete the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
sections.instructionsVi: Trả lời câu 1-5. Điền vào chỗ trống không quá hai từ và/hoặc một số.
sections.audioText: Hello students, welcome to the university campus accommodation briefing. My name is Alan Roberts, the head residential warden. I will guide you through the key regulations for this academic year. First, regarding communal dining: the main dining hall serves breakfast every morning between 7:00 and 9:30 AM. For lunch and dinner, you can either dine at the cafeteria or prepare your own meals in the kitchen pod located on each floor. Remember that all cooking equipment must be switched off immediately after use to prevent fire alarms. Second, your electronic room keycards: your keycard grants 24-hour access to your residential block, the computer laboratory, and the study library. If you happen to misplace your card, please report immediately to the administration desk on Level 1. A replacement card costs fifteen pounds. Third, quiet hours are strictly enforced between 11:00 PM and 7:00 AM on weekdays, and after midnight on weekends. Visitors must register at the reception lobby and are not permitted to stay overnight without prior written permission from the warden. Finally, for parcel deliveries, all packages will be held at the central post room opposite the sports center. You will receive an automated email notification when a package arrives under your student registration number. Have a pleasant and productive year ahead!
sections.audioTranscript:
Hello students, welcome to the university campus accommodation briefing. My name is Alan Roberts, the head residential warden. I will guide you through the key regulations for this academic year.

First, regarding communal dining: the main dining hall serves breakfast every morning between 7:00 and 9:30 AM. For lunch and dinner, you can either dine at the cafeteria or prepare your own meals in the kitchen pod located on each floor. Remember that all cooking equipment must be switched off immediately after use to prevent fire alarms.

Second, your electronic room keycards: your keycard grants 24-hour access to your residential block, the computer laboratory, and the study library. If you happen to misplace your card, please report immediately to the administration desk on Level 1. A replacement card costs fifteen pounds.

Third, quiet hours are strictly enforced between 11:00 PM and 7:00 AM on weekdays, and after midnight on weekends. Visitors must register at the reception lobby and are not permitted to stay overnight without prior written permission from the warden.

Finally, for parcel deliveries, all packages will be held at the central post room opposite the sports center. You will receive an automated email notification when a package arrives under your student registration number. Have a pleasant and productive year ahead!

sections.title: Reading Passage 1: The Renewable Energy Transition
sections.titleVi: Bài Đọc 1: Bước Chuyển Dịch Sang Năng Lượng Tái Tạo Toàn Cầu
sections.instructions: Read the passage below and answer Questions 6-10 according to the instructions.
sections.instructionsVi: Đọc bài đọc dưới đây và trả lời các câu hỏi từ 6 đến 10.
sections.passageTitle: The Renewable Energy Transition: Infrastructure, Economics, and Storage
sections.passageTitleVi: Chuyển Đổi Năng Lượng Tái Tạo: Cơ Sở Hạ Tầng, Kinh Tế và Lưu Trữ Điện
sections.passageText:
Paragraph A: The global transition away from fossil fuels toward sustainable energy vectors is frequently characterized as the most intricate technological undertaking of modern civilization. Unlike the historical shift from coal to petroleum during the early twentieth century, which was propelled primarily by energy density and extraction economics, the contemporary impetus is predominantly environmental and geopolitical. International decarbonization accords obligate sovereign nations to curtail carbon dioxide emissions while simultaneously sustaining industrial power demands.

Paragraph B: Wind turbines and solar photovoltaic generation have achieved unprecedented cost parity with conventional thermoelectric plants across most equatorial and temperate latitudes. However, their fundamental intermittency introduces severe grid instability. Without grid-scale electrical storage solutions, sudden shifts in atmospheric meteorological conditions can precipitate severe frequency fluctuations across high-voltage transmission networks, threatening sudden blackouts.

Paragraph C: Lithium-iron-phosphate (LFP) battery chemistry has gained preeminence for short-duration storage, offering approximately four to six hours of discharge capacity. Yet, addressing multi-week seasonal imbalances in high-latitude territories demands seasonal chemical carriers, notably electrolytic green hydrogen or ammonia synthesis. Engineering analysts caution that transforming existing subterranean pipeline infrastructure to transport hydrogen incurs considerable metallurgical embrittlement concerns that require substantial capital investment.

Paragraph D: Market analysts emphasize that policy frameworks must harmonize economic incentives with transmission modernization. Feed-in tariffs, carbon pricing corridors, and subsidized grid interconnectors are critical instruments to ensure that renewable energy generation capacity can be integrated seamlessly into metropolitan consumption nodes without stranding legacy electrical assets.

questions.prompt: The 20th-century transition to petroleum was mainly motivated by environmental concerns.
questions.promptVi: Quá trình chuyển đổi sang dầu mỏ vào thế kỷ 20 chủ yếu được thúc đẩy bởi các lo ngại về môi trường.
questions.explanation: Paragraph A states that the shift to petroleum 'was propelled primarily by energy density and extraction economics,' whereas the contemporary (today's) impetus is environmental.
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn A nêu rõ bước chuyển đổi thế kỷ 20 bắt nguồn từ mật độ năng lượng và bài toán kinh tế khai thác dầu, trong khi lý do môi trường là của thời điểm hiện tại. Do đó câu khẳng định mâu thuẫn trực tiếp với bài (FALSE).
questions.evidenceText: Unlike the historical shift from coal to petroleum during the early twentieth century, which was propelled primarily by energy density and extraction economics, the contemporary impetus is predominantly environmental and geopolitical.
questions.trapNoteVi: Bẫy phủ định mâu thuẫn: Bài đọc chỉ rõ lý do là kinh tế và mật độ năng lượng, đối lập với nhận định 'environmental concerns'.

sections.title: Writing Module: Task 2 Academic Essay
sections.titleVi: Phần Viết: IELTS Writing Task 2 Bài Luận Học Thuật
sections.instructions: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
sections.instructionsVi: Bạn nên dành khoảng 40 phút cho phần này. Viết tối thiểu 250 từ.

questions.prompt: Some people believe that artificial intelligence will completely replace human educators in schools and universities in the future. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
questions.promptVi: Một số người tin rằng trí tuệ nhân tạo sẽ thay thế hoàn toàn giáo viên con người tại các trường học và đại học trong tương lai. Bạn đồng ý hay không đồng ý đến mức độ nào?
questions.correctAnswer: Bài mẫu & Tiêu chí chấm Band 7.5+
questions.explanation: A high-scoring response (Band 7.5+) must clearly establish a balanced stance (e.g., partial disagreement), addressing how AI can assist with grading, customized pacing, and content retrieval, while emphasizing why human teachers remain irreplaceable for moral guidance, emotional intelligence, critical thinking facilitation, and social mentorship.
questions.explanationVi: Bài viết đạt Band 7.5+ cần có quan điểm rõ ràng, cấu trúc 4 đoạn mạch lạc: Mở bài nêu lập trường, Thân bài 1 phân tích năng lực vượt trội của AI trong cá nhân hóa bài giảng, Thân bài 2 khẳng định vai trò không thể thay thế của giáo viên ở phương diện trí tuệ cảm xúc và tư duy phản biện, Kết bài khẳng định sự kết hợp cộng sinh thay vì thay thế hoàn toàn.
